title: Poll usage record (DB-MSG-POLL-USAGE, msg.poll_usage)
description: One counter row of the chat-poll usage measurement (docs/pilot/poll-usage/README.md section 4): counts only, no poll question, option, answer or person. Mirrors the operator-written columns of msg.poll_usage in SCHEMA-gremion.md (DB-MSG-POLL-USAGE); the bookkeeping columns (ids, created_*, updated_*, row_version, recorded_at) are written by the table, not by the operator. Unique per customer, body, period and source.

period_start.description: no earlier than the council's go-live (section 3)
